title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Enrollment Standard — Agreements per Customer and per Premise
content:
**Standard.** A residential customer may hold up to 4 Beacon Ridge gas agreements under Residential Natural Gas Supply at the same time, one per premise. An agreement counts toward that limit while its status is enrollment pending, active or drop pending.

**One live agreement per premise.** No other gas agreement on the same premise may be in enrollment pending, active or drop pending status when a new gas enrollment is submitted. A second enrollment on such a premise is refused, and the customer is offered a plan change on the existing agreement instead.

**Basis of the check.** The check rests on the company's system records, not on the customer's account of them: the premise and the status shown on the existing gas agreements for that same premise, read before the new enrollment is submitted. The premise of the new enrollment is the premise matched.

### Status of an existing gas agreement on the same premise

| Status of the existing agreement | Counts toward the limit of 4 | New gas enrollment on that premise |
|---|---|---|
| enrollment pending | Yes | refused; plan change on the existing agreement offered |
| active | Yes | refused; plan change on the existing agreement offered |
| drop pending | Yes | refused; plan change on the existing agreement offered |
| closed, rescinded or rejected | No | not blocked by that agreement |

### Illustrations (hypothetical households)

- A customer holds active agreements at three premises and an enrollment pending at a fourth: four agreements count, which is the most the customer may hold at the same time.
- A customer's agreement at a premise closed after a move-out; a new gas enrollment at that same premise is not blocked by the closed agreement.
- A customer's agreement at a premise is drop pending after a confirmed cancellation; a new enrollment at that premise is refused and a plan change on the existing agreement is offered instead.
